pages.title: Enchanted Plants
pages.text: Each Enchanted Plant carries a distinct ability that influences the world around it. Their effects vary from transformation and growth to protection and manipulation.

pages.title: Morphora
pages.text: Activated with $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/mutation)Mutavis$(/l), Morphora spreads mutation across nearby blocks, allowing multiple transformations at once.

pages.title: Grimshade
pages.text: Activated with a Hex Focus, Grimshade transforms Skeletons into Wither Skeletons and converts nearby skulls into withered variants. It also emits an aura that inflicts Wither and Weakness on nearby non-player creatures.

pages.title: Nautilite
pages.text: Activate Nautilite with a Hex Focus to receive Conduit Power and shed Mining Fatigue. The awakening also harms nearby Guardians and Drowned, and Mining Fatigue is kept at bay while the blessing lasts.

pages.title: Windsong
pages.text: Activated with a Hex Focus, Windsong creates a barrier that blocks incoming projectiles within its area of influence.

pages.title: Astrylis
pages.text: Activated with a Celestial Crystal, Astrylis accelerates nearby crops and saplings, acting as a sustained source of natural growth.

pages.title: Lourdes
pages.text: When fed a $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#lotus_blossom)Lotus Blossom$(/l), Lourdes releases a restorative aura that grants Regeneration and removes negative effects. Its influence is stronger on animals.

pages.title: Aegiflora
pages.text: Aegiflora prevents creeper explosions within its area. After triggering its effect, it withers away and becomes a dead bush.

pages.title: On Mastery
pages.text: Each plant serves a different purpose, from shaping terrain to protecting life. Understanding their effects allows for powerful environmental control when used with intent.
